subject: Renewal: Buildkite agents + container-registry add-on — quote review
messages:
From: Tina Lopez <tina@buildkite.com>
To: dylan_brooks@gmail.com, lauren_bishop@gmail.com
Cc: marcus_lin@gmail.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal quote: Buildkite Agents + Container Registry partner add-on

Hi Dylan / Lauren / Marcus,

Thanks for the conversation last week. Attached is the formal renewal quote for Redwood Inference's Buildkite subscription (12 concurrent agents, pro support) for 2026-2027, plus pricing for our container registry add-on (powered by ContainerHub) at your request. Key highlights: 

- Annual term, 12 agents: $120,000/year (base)
- Pro support: $18,000/year
- ContainerRegistry add-on (private images, geo-replication): $28,500/year
- 10% multi-year discount if you commit for 2 years

I've included a spreadsheet with tiered discounts and a recommended configuration based on your reported concurrency patterns. If you'd like, Oliver from ContainerHub can join a call next week to walk the security and egress details.

Attachments: BK_renewal_quote_Mar2026.pdf, containerhub_pricing_matrix.xlsx

Let me know if you want me to convert this into a consolidated PO-ready doc.

Best,
Tina Lopez
Account Executive, Buildkite
From: dylan_brooks@gmail.com
To: lauren_bishop@gmail.com
Cc: marcus_lin@gmail.com
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote: Buildkite Agents + Container Registry partner add-on

Team —

Forwarding Tina's quote for visibility. Our current term ends May 1; procurement wants a decision by Apr 2 to avoid auto-renewal and to line up budget. Quick notes:

- Buildkite is what we run in production; migration cost to CircleCI would be non-trivial and would likely exceed the first-year savings.
- The container registry add-on addresses geo-replication and private image signing (SIV) which we need for Europe region deployments.
- Total asked spend if we stay: ~$166.5k/yr pre-discount. With a 2-year 10% commit, looks like ~$299k for two years.

Questions for this thread:
1) Do we renew Buildkite+add-on as-is?
2) Should we negotiate the agent count down to 10 and enable burst pools instead?
3) Do we ask Finance for a one-time migration budget to evaluate CircleCI + GitHub Packages parallel run?

Please respond with your recommendation and any procurement constraints. I can book a 30-min sync if needed.

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
From: lauren_bishop@gmail.com
To: dylan_brooks@gmail.com, marcus_lin@gmail.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote: Buildkite Agents + Container Registry partner add-on

Thanks — quick take from my side (procurement):

- Procurement prefers at least 3 competitive quotes for any >$100k ARR vendor renewal. Buildkite is preferred tech-wise but we should collect an apples-to-apples comparison.
- CircleCI pricing for comparable concurrency looks ~20% cheaper on list, but their container registry (if we use GitHub Packages or Docker Hub) lacks geo-replication options out-of-the-box. Additional networking/egress costs could negate savings.
- Proposal: ask Tina to provide (a) a best-and-final with agent flexibility (10-14 range) and (b) a line-item for just the registry (no pro support) — we sometimes decouple support for cost reasons.

I can start an RFP-lite: 1) Buildkite (current), 2) CircleCI enterprise, 3) self-hosted registry with CDN (estimate from ContainerHub and an internal SRE uplift). Will loop procurement and legal for the SLA and data residency questions.

Cc'ing procurement is deliberate — we need their sign-off on the negotiation approach.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@gmail.com
To: dylan_brooks@gmail.com, lauren_bishop@gmail.com
Cc: oliver@containerhub.io
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal quote: Buildkite Agents + Container Registry partner add-on

Looping back after quick review of the attachments. I ran a 12-month TCO doc (attached: TCO_buildkite_vs_circleci_2026.docx) and flagged the following: 

- Migration to CircleCI would require ~2 FTE months of SRE effort (pipeline rewrites, secrets/connectors, and agent autoscaling validation). That plus parallel run costs would push year-1 total higher by ~35%.
- If we negotiate Buildkite down to 10 agents and enable burst capacity (+1 agent pool for spikes), list + support + registry comes to ~$150k/yr. With a 2-year commit we could target $135k/yr.
- ContainerHub (Oliver) confirmed they can add EU geo-replication but quoted per-GB egress fees for replication — we should push for either a cap or a fixed price for the first year.

Action items:
- Lauren: please ask Buildkite for a revised quote with 10-agent baseline + burst pool option and a separate registry-only SKU. Also ask for a multi-year discount ladder.
- Lauren: please request formal bids from CircleCI and Docker Hub (or GitHub Packages commercial) for comparison.
- Dylan/Marcus: I recommend approving the revised 2-year commit if Buildkite hits ~$135k/yr or less. Otherwise, prepare a migration budget estimate for FY27.

Attachments: containerhub_pricing_matrix.xlsx (from Tina), TCO_buildkite_vs_circleci_2026.docx

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
